name: Fragrant sumac
desc: Fragrant sumac (Rhus aromatica): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Rhus aromatica, commonly known as fragrant sumac, smooth sumac, aromatic sumac, lemon sumac, skunk bush, polecat bush, polecat sumac, or simply sumac, is a deciduous shrub in the family Anacardiaceae…
